## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue when one exists.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. Explain any relevant checks you could not run.
For UI changes, include desktop/mobile and Light/Dark evidence using synthetic data.

## Compatibility and documentation

- [ ] Local-first storage, existing documents and backups remain compatible, or a migration is included.
- [ ] Relevant UI, API, MCP, OpenAPI and Help changes are consistent.
- [ ] Tests cover meaningful changed behavior; secrets and user data are excluded.
- [ ] License and third-party notices are preserved.

Mark items that do not apply and explain briefly. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Caripson/visualnerve/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Deployments remain a separate manual maintainer action.
